purpose: Test the concrete off-shell mechanism exposed by Repair08/09: the frozen GE15 CLASS background contains a cosmological-constant sector, while the GE19 reduced H1 operator currently contains only GE06 Einstein+AeST plus GE07 pressureless dust. Quantify the homogeneous lapse and isotropic-spatial residuals before changing the linear operator.

comparators: reduced plus frozen CLASS Lambda: rho=C/a^3+rho_lambda, p=-rho_lambda

routing_logic.BACKGROUND_NORMALIZATION_OR_INTERPOLATIO: full known density or pressure comparator does not close within the predeclared controls

no GE06 or GE07 equation is edited

no sign or threshold is changed

next_step_policy: Only after this audit may a separately preregistered repair add the frozen Lambda action and its first/second directional metric coefficients to the reduced operator and repeat Stage A.
claim_boundary: Background/action normalization audit only; no finite eta, nonlinear-amplitude, collapse, lensing or observational claim.
